blind.description: A stylized butcher shop ceiling rack consisting of a horizontal metal pipe held by two short chains and ceiling mounting plates. Five curved S-hooks hang from the bar, suspending food items: a bundle of garlic or onions with green stems, a whole plucked poultry/chicken, a link of red sausages, a thick slab of bacon/pork belly with fat striations, and a large cured ham leg. Textures and geometry are clean, continuous, and stylized.
blind.from_above: A straight horizontal grey metal rod with hexagonal caps at each end, showing hooks looped over it and the tops of the various hanging meats and vegetables protruding underneath, casting a detailed shadow above-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: Total height from ceiling plates to the lowest meat tip is about half the height of the figure (around 2.5 to 3 feet tall), with a rail width of approximately 3 feet.

notes: Height is slightly taller than catalog target due to ceiling chains and mounting plates
